name: al-app-docs
description: The Altitude documentation site. Every component-shaped surface — sidebar taxonomy, counts, index, props tables, code snippets — is generated at build time from libs/al-web-components/custom-elements.json (see src/lib/registry.mjs). Design language is fixed by the approved canvas at .mm/specs/2026-08-22-altitude-docs-site/visuals/altitude-ds-site.dc.html.

scripts.//build: Astro emits to ../../dist/docs, then Pagefind indexes that BUILT output in place. Pagefind is a post-build indexer, not a plugin: it reads the emitted HTML, so it must run after astro build and against the same directory astro.config.mjs points outDir at.
